children.text: Get started with Meetily on macOS or Windows
Full access to every Pro feature. No credit card required.
For professionals who need speaker diarization and advanced features.
Built in the open. MIT licensed. Runs entirely on your machine: real-time transcription, AI summaries, and 100% local processing. Your conversations stay on your device by default.
Native macOS and Windows desktop apps are available now. A native Linux desktop app is in development.

children.q: What is the difference between Community and Pro?
children.a: Community Edition is free for individuals and runs the same local transcription engine as Pro. Pro adds a custom model connector, auto-detect meetings, calendar integration, speaker diarization, custom summary templates, and priority support.

children.q: Is the Community Edition free?
children.a: Yes! The Community Edition is completely free with no hidden costs. Includes real-time transcription, AI summaries, and 100% local processing.

children.q: What platforms are supported?
children.a: Meetily ships native desktop apps for Windows (EXE) and macOS (.dmg). Both Community and Pro versions support both platforms. For Linux today, build the app bundle from source via the open-source repo (github.com/Zackriya-Solutions/meetily); a native Linux desktop app is in development - join the waitlist at /granola-for-linux.

children.q: Do I need internet to use Meetily?
children.a: Transcription runs locally on your device by default. For summaries, you choose: local AI (offline) or your own API key (BYOK). Internet is only needed for download, optional updates, and if you choose a cloud-based summary provider.

children.q: Is my data safe?
children.a: Yes! All processing happens locally on your device. No data is sent to external servers. Your meetings and transcripts stay private.

children.q: How long is the Pro trial?
children.a: The Pro trial is 14 days with full Pro features and flexible AI summaries (local or BYOK). No credit card required to start. After the trial you get a 1-day grace period, and your trial license is valid for activation within a 14-day window.

children.q: Do you offer a refund?
children.a: Yes. Pro includes a 30-day money-back guarantee. If Pro is not the right fit, email support within 30 days of purchase and we will refund you in full.

children.q: How much does Pro cost?
children.a: $10/user/month billed annually (60% off the $25/month regular price). 30-day money-back guarantee.

children.q: How are summaries generated and what data is sent?
children.a: Summaries are pluggable. Run a local model to keep everything on-device, or bring your own API key (Claude, OpenAI, Groq, OpenRouter, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint). With BYOK, only the transcript text is sent to your chosen provider. Audio and recordings never leave your device.

children.q: How does BYOK (Bring Your Own Key) work?
children.a: Bring your own API key from Anthropic, OpenAI, Groq, OpenRouter, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. You pay your provider directly, you control data retention and routing. See the per-provider privacy summaries at /llm-privacy for retention and zero-data-retention details.

children.q: Does Meetily send audio to the cloud for summaries?
children.a: No. Transcription runs locally by default, and on that path audio and recordings never leave your device. For summaries with BYOK, only the transcript text is sent to your chosen AI provider. If you prefer fully local, pair Meetily with Ollama.

children.q: Is Pro for individuals or teams?
children.a: Both. Pro is licensed per user at $10/user/month billed annually. You can buy a single seat for yourself or multiple seats for a team. For larger orgs with procurement or custom terms, talk to us about Enterprise.

children.q: Is Linux supported?
children.a: Pro ships native installers for Windows and macOS today. A native Linux build is in development - join the waitlist at /granola-for-linux. The Community Edition can be built from source on Linux today.

children.q: Can I cancel anytime?
children.a: Yes. You can cancel anytime from your billing portal. Cancellation takes effect at the end of your current annual term, and you retain Pro access until then.

children.q: What's the difference between Pro and Community?
children.a: Community is free under MIT license with local transcription, AI summaries, audio import, and retranscription. Pro adds flexible AI summaries (local or BYOK), custom summary templates, advanced exports (PDF / DOCX / Markdown), connections to your AI assistant and your own scripts (MCP, webhooks, command-line tool), and email priority support.

children.q: What happens after the 14-day trial ends?
children.a: When your trial ends you can purchase Pro at $10/user/month billed annually, or fall back to Community Edition (free, MIT) with no data loss. Trial licenses are valid for activation within a 14-day window.

children.q: What payment methods do you accept?
children.a: Payments are processed via Lemon Squeezy. We accept all major credit and debit cards. Pro is $10/user/month billed annually.

children.q: What happens after my trial ends?
children.a: After 14 days, Pro features will be disabled but your data remains safe on your device. You can continue using Community features for free, or purchase a Pro license to restore full functionality. There's also a 1-day grace period after the trial ends.

children.q: Can I use Meetily completely free?
children.a: Yes! Meetily Community Edition is free and open source. Transcription runs on your device, and summaries run on a local model by default or through your own API key. Pro adds naming your speakers, cloud and custom transcription providers, and advanced exports.

children.q: How do I activate my license?
children.a: Open Meetily and follow the setup steps; at the license step, paste your license key and click Activate. It takes just seconds. Your trial key is shown on screen when you request it, and paid keys arrive by email after purchase. Trial keys must be activated within 14 days of generation.

children.q: What payment methods do you accept?
children.a: We accept all major credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express), PayPal, and Apple Pay through our secure payment partner LemonSqueezy. All transactions are encrypted and secure.

children.q: Can I get a refund?
children.a: Yes, we offer a 30-day money-back guarantee. If you're not satisfied with Meetily Pro, contact us at meetily@zackriya.com for a full refund, no questions asked.

children.q: Do I need an internet connection?
children.a: Meetily transcription runs locally on your device. You need internet for license activation, downloading the app, and downloading local AI models. Recordings and audio never leave your device. For summaries, you choose your provider: local AI or your own API key (BYOK).

children.q: What's the difference between Pro Trial and Pro?
children.a: Pro Trial gives you full access to all Pro features for 14 days at no cost. After the trial, you can purchase a Pro license ($120/year) to continue using Pro features. The only difference is the duration - trial is 14 days, paid is 1 year.

children.q: Can I use the same license on multiple devices?
children.a: Each Pro license is valid for one device. If you need licenses for multiple devices or team members, contact us about Enterprise plans which offer volume licensing with discounts.

children.q: Can I use the same license on multiple devices?
children.a: Each Pro license is valid for one device. If you need licenses for multiple devices or team members, you can purchase multiple licenses or check out our Enterprise plan for volume discounts.

children.q: Do I need an internet connection?
